title: Seminormality and absolute weak normality are local properties of rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that being seminormal, and being absolutely weakly normal, are local properties of rings in the sense of the corresponding Properties definition. For the passage to a localisation of a seminormal ring the proof clears denominators in the relation between the two elements, applies the defining property of seminormality in the unlocalised ring and divides the resulting element by the power of the localising element, keeping track of uniqueness. For the converse direction it assumes the localisations at a finite family generating the unit ideal are seminormal, applies the defining property on each piece, glues the resulting elements over the pairwise localisations using the standard covering lemma, and reads the equations back in the original ring; the absolutely weakly normal case is a repetition of the same two arguments.
